description_en: Retrieves the overview data of task scheduling for a professional edition application
description_zh: 获取专业版应用任务调度概览数据信息
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 get-overview --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --operate query --metric-type 0 --start-time 1684166400 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetOverview

parameters.help_en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for special third-party integrations
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间来源，特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

query: queries interval data.
query_range: queries interval time series data
parameters.help_zh:
可选项

query：查询区间数据
query_range：查询区间时许数据
parameters.name: operate

parameters.help_en:
The metric type. Valid values:

0: basic task information.
1: task execution information
parameters.help_zh:
可选项

0：任务类基础信息
1：任务运行信息
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the data, in seconds. Example: 1684166400
parameters.help_zh: 数据起始时间戳（单位：秒），如：1684166400
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the data, in seconds. Example: 1684166400. If this parameter is not specified, the current time is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
数据结束时间戳（单位：秒），如：1684166400 
不填默认为当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

Data.description_en:
The overview data in JSON format, which corresponds to the overview data on the console. The result is returned in one of the following three formats:
Basic information.
Node runtime information within a time interval.
Node runtime timing information within a time interval. This format returns statistics information at each time point for three data items: node triggers, successful executions, and failed executions
Data.description_zh:
JSON的概览数据信息，对应控制台概览数据内容，如下三种格式类型结果：
基础信息。
时间区间任务运行信息。
时间区间任务运行时序信息：返回对应区间任务触发、运行成功、运行失败三个数据项对应时点的统计信息

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only when an error occurs
Message.description_zh: 错误信息，仅出错时返回错误信息
Message.example: No access permission for the namespace [***]

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
API调用是否成功。取值如下：

true：成功。
false：失败
